# e2b_sandbox_metric_history (Data Source)

Reads E2B metric history for one sandbox.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_sandbox_metric_history" "example" {
  sandbox_id = "sbx_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sandbox_id` (String) Sandbox ID.

### Optional

- `end` (Number) Optional Unix timestamp for the end of the interval, in seconds.
- `start` (Number) Optional Unix timestamp for the start of the interval, in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `metrics` (Attributes List) Metric points returned by E2B. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `cpu_used_pct` (Number) CPU usage percentage.
- `disk_total` (Number) Total disk space in bytes.
- `disk_used` (Number) Disk used in bytes.
- `mem_cache` (Number) Cached memory in bytes.
- `mem_total` (Number) Total memory in bytes.
- `mem_used` (Number) Memory used in bytes.
- `timestamp` (String) Deprecated RFC3339 timestamp returned by E2B.
- `timestamp_unix` (Number) Unix timestamp for the metric point.
